title: The organism that eats your brain 🦠 #shorts
description: Naegleria fowleri enters through the nose and destroys the brain. #shorts #animals #nature #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's a tiny organism in warm water that can eat your brain? It's called Naegleria fowleri. It lives in warm lakes and rivers, and it's usually harmless to swallow. But if it goes up your nose, everything changes. It travels along the nerve that carries smell, straight into your brain, and begins to feed. It starts with a headache and a lost sense of smell... and within a week, it's almost always fatal. Barely anyone has ever survived it.
captions: An organism that EATS your brain?
Naegleria fowleri.
Swallowing it is harmless...
...but if it goes up your nose, it climbs to your brain.
It's almost always fatal within a week.

title: The maggots that eat you alive 🪰 #shorts
description: Screwworm larvae burrow into and feed on living flesh. #shorts #animals #nature #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's a fly whose young eat you while you're still alive? It's the screwworm. Most maggots only feed on the dead, but this one is different. A fly lays its eggs in the smallest open wound, and when they hatch, the larvae screw themselves down into living flesh, feeding as they burrow deeper. The wound grows instead of healing, drawing more flies to lay more eggs. Left alone, an infestation can kill a full-grown cow... or a person.
captions: Maggots that eat you ALIVE?
The screwworm.
Most maggots only eat the dead...
...but these burrow into living flesh.
An infestation can kill a cow, or a person.

title: The worm that crawls across your eye 👁️ #shorts
description: The Loa loa worm migrates through the body and across the eyeball. #shorts #animals #nature #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's a worm that can crawl across your eyeball while you watch? It's called Loa loa, the African eye worm. It enters your body through the bite of a fly, then lives beneath your skin, wandering slowly through your tissue for years. Most of the time you'd never know. But every so often, it decides to travel across the surface of your eye, a visible thread sliding under the lens, in full view... before disappearing back into your face.
captions: A worm that crawls across your EYE?
The Loa loa worm.
A fly bite puts it under your skin...
...where it wanders your body for years.
Then it slides across your eyeball in plain view.

title: The snake called the kiss of death 🐍 #shorts
description: The black mamba is fast, aggressive, and its bite is nearly always fatal. #shorts #animals #nature #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's a snake so deadly its bite was once called the kiss of death? It's the black mamba. It can race across the ground at nearly twelve miles an hour, faster than most people can sprint. When cornered, it rears up, spreads a thin hood, and opens a mouth that's inky black inside. A single bite delivers enough neurotoxin to kill a dozen people, shutting down the body in as little as twenty minutes. Before antivenom, its bite was almost always a death sentence.
captions: A snake called the KISS OF DEATH?
The black mamba.
It races faster than you can sprint...
...rears up with a jet-black mouth.
One bite can kill a dozen people.

title: The reptile with the strongest bite 🐊 #shorts
description: The saltwater crocodile has the most powerful bite ever measured. #shorts #animals #nature #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's an animal that bites down harder than a T. rex is thought to have? It's the saltwater crocodile, the largest reptile alive, over twenty feet long. It floats like a silent log, eyes barely above the surface, then explodes upward with a bite that crushes bone instantly. Once it has you, it drags you under and spins, the death roll, twisting until its prey is torn apart. It's an ambush hunter that has changed little in a hundred million years... and it sees humans as food.
captions: The strongest bite ever measured?
The saltwater crocodile.
It floats silent, like a log...
...then explodes up and crushes bone.
Then the death roll tears prey apart.

title: The animal with a contagious cancer 😈 #shorts
description: A transmissible facial cancer is wiping out the Tasmanian devil. #shorts #animals #nature #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's an animal dying from a cancer that spreads between individuals like a disease? It's the Tasmanian devil. It has one of the strongest bites for its size of any mammal, able to crush bone, and it fights viciously, biting others on the face. But those bites carry something horrifying: a contagious cancer. Living tumor cells pass from one devil's mouth into another's wounds, growing into grotesque facial tumors that make it impossible to eat. It has erased most of the population... a cancer that is, itself, alive and spreading.
captions: An animal with a CONTAGIOUS cancer?
The Tasmanian devil.
It fights by biting others' faces...
...spreading living tumor cells between them.
The cancer has wiped out most of them.
